title: A Deep Dive into the Trade-Offs of Parameter-Efficient Preference Alignment Techniques

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxic generation by scoring outputs with a toxicity-classification reward model on the RealToxicity dataset, and measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) on Red-Instruct's DangerousQA dataset.

Assessed collectively as a component of the model's 'harmlessness' alignment using Red-Instruct's DangerousQA dataset, which comprises harmful questions specifically spanning racist, sexist, and stereotypical adjectives.
